sources.title: AfriqueQwen3.5: open language model | AxForge
sources.snippet: AfriqueQwen3.5-4B is a causal language model developed by McGill-NLP for text generation, specifically adapted for 20 African languages through continued pre-training on approximately 26 billion tokens. The model is based on Qwen3.5-4B-Base and features a native context length of 32,768 tokens. It is released under the CC BY 4.0 license.
